text: No, the evidence does not show forest loss across the surrounding region for the claim period (2021–2025). The assessment status is "NOT_DETECTED," meaning no tree-cover loss events ≥0.5 ha occurred within the asset boundary during this time. While historical losses (pre-2021) are recorded—totaling 98.8 ha across 2008–2020—the post-baseline period shows only minor, sub-threshold losses (0.4 ha in 2021, not counted as events). The data sources (Hansen GFC and JRC GFC2020) confirm no significant changes, supporting compliance with the claim scope.
